items.text: **The 4 uncited preset legal claims** (`lib/compliance/required-doc-presets.ts`) need a human compliance task: find and verify each official URL. Until then they seed as brokerage policy, and the settings card says so. I did not invent citations.

**Deal-side subtype / representation are rarely KNOWN.** No column on offers/transactions records them. 143B open item 1 and Outside-lane 4 still stand. A brokerage-term rule applies as a warning until a caller passes the value.
**Financing subtype persistence.** `vocabularyWriteValue` hands back `subtype`, but no writer stores it yet. The proposal is `offers.metadata.financing_subtype` / `transactions` (Outside-lane 1).

**One open vocabulary proposal per brokerage at a time.** This holds for the kernel's dedup on the policy key, and separately for coming-soon. A second report is refused with "decide the open one first".

**Generic Manager Trust promotion bypasses my re-validation and compliance-role check.** It is fail-closed: a state-scoped term or coming-soon rule promoted there lands UNATTESTED and is not usable until a compliance approver attests it. A kernel hook is proposed in Outside-lane 4.

**Platform-owned dimensions** (closing participants, housing topics, document classifications, stage ladder) answer a report with why and where, and record nothing. A platform-level correction queue for them is an owner decision.

**A kernel rollback of an "add" removes the entry** (the kernel's generic restore). It is an explicit human revert, not a silent delete, but a rule naming that term then reads as unrecognised: it applies as a warning, and the DB trigger keeps refusing edits of that column.
**The MLS source test is partly human.** An MLS is private, so the deterministic check is https + MLS name + rule section, and the compliance approver attests that the URL is that MLS's own rules.

**Financing pickers / writers read the ONE list and store the roll-up.** - Files that retype the list: `app/actions/buyer-financial.ts:71`, `app/crm/components/financial-verification-panel.tsx:36,326`, `app/crm/contacts/[contactId]/buyer-overview-client.tsx:219,929`, `app/crm/contacts/[contactId]/offers/components/offer-initiation-flow.tsx:762`, `lib/ai-isa/convert-buyer-lead-on-intent.ts:104` (144F), `lib/forms/for…

**`lib/state-forms/field-defs.ts:163` (unowned).** `OFFER_FIELD_DEFS.contractType` (residential, as_is, new_construction, land, commercial) is a second contract-type vocabulary (§6). Owner decision: map residential→standard. `as_is`, `land` and `commercial` are condition / property type, not contract subtype.

**Callers that know the deal's subtype / representation should pass them** (carried from 143B Outside-lane 4): `lib/transactions/transaction-creation-gate.ts:502`, `lib/listings/listing-activation-gate.ts:449`, `app/actions/buyer-offer/submit-to-compliance.ts:212`.

**`lib/kernel/improvement-proposals.ts` (kernel / 144I).** In `evaluateImprovement` case `policy` (settings) for `subject_key ∈ {adaptive_vocabulary, coming_soon_policy}`, call `validateVocabularyChange(change, live)` / `validateComingSoonPolicyReport`, and set `verdict:"fail"` on errors. In `decideProposal`, require `VOCABULARY_COMPLIANCE_APPROVER_USER_TYPES` when `proposed_change.requires_compliance === true`. Thi…

**Lane 144B, `lib/listing-lifecycle/readiness-checker.ts`.** At COMING_SOON_ACTIVE, run `const p = await loadComingSoonPolicy(svc, brokerageId); const r = evaluateComingSoonReadiness(p.ok ? p.policy : null, { mlsSlug, stateCode: listing.state, daysInComingSoon, showingsScheduled, businessDaysSincePublicMarketing })`. `!r.ready` blocks with `r.blockers`; unknown blocks too, which is the closed default.

**`lib/compliance-rules/fair-housing-patterns.ts` (unowned).** Ruling 17 makes military / divorce service topics, not exemptions. The scan has no preference patterns for them. Proposed (needs compliance review): `/\b(military|veterans?)\s+only\b/i` (military status, state-protected in several markets) and `/\bno\s+(divorced|single\s+parents?)\b/i` (marital / familial status).

**AI managers / tools.** The data steward should be able to call `reportVocabularyGap` when it meets an unreadable value (e.g. the value-normalizer's `unresolved` list). That is a tool registration (`lib/ai-isa/persona-tool-policy.ts` / tool catalogue). It stays a REPORT, never a promotion (LAW 4).
**`scripts/closing-compliance-guard.ts` A1** (C/D) reads the m806 FILE, so it stays green after m847. No change is needed. I noted it so nobody "fixes" it to the live cache.

**The database is in memory.** The m847 trigger, the `tenant_adaptive_vocabulary` RPC (and its 42501), RLS and the citation CHECK are proven by their SQL text (guard A4), not executed. The kernel promotion, ledger, policy versions and attestation ran for real against `scripts/in-memory-supabase.ts`.

**Cache freshness.** `scripts/check-vocabularies.ts` is as fresh as its last regeneration (2026-10-23). After m847 PART B the two brd CHECKs leave the cache; guard A2 then requires m847's DROP + trigger instead (it asserts the rule, not the waypoint).
**Copy counting.** The scattered-copy finder counts ≥3 financing literals on ONE line. A list split across lines is not counted.
**Similarity is token overlap.** It proposes candidates; a person decides alias vs new term.

**Concurrency.** Approval re-validates against the live vocabulary, but the kernel merges the stored patch moments later. A concurrent vocabulary edit in between is not detected beyond `mergeBrokerageSettings`' optimistic version check.

**Fixtures.** The guard's coming-soon MLS is a FIXTURE (`example-coast-mls.test`), not a real MLS rule. The TREC IABS URL used for the Texas intermediary fixture was fetched 2026-10-25 and its page defines "intermediary".
None. No provider, key, env var, Stripe, Vercel or purchase is involved. Applying m847 is the integrator's step (Supabase MCP), not an external dependency.

Topic evidence is a SIGNAL from the search rail (questions surfaced + topic bank + titles/snippets the same rail returns) — no sales or rank data; a topic the rail cannot see reads "positioning not researched". Never a bestseller prediction.

Broadcast licence SCOPE of a music bed is not machine-checkable (the platform holds the licence link, not its terms) — the launch package says so; a human confirms per buy.
The rights notice is display text; its legal sufficiency is not proven here.

`classifyProxyPath("/legal")` is "open" (not public-listed, not protected) — reachable without a session today; a future PROTECTED_ROUTES prefix that matched `/legal` would hide it (guard M would fail).

**Change-request trigger.** A change request is triggered by the model's `rootCause: code_defect`. A code defect the model mislabels as `configuration` still reaches the bounded playbook path. The hard gate, policy and attempt cap still bound that path, and it can never edit code.
